Low-pressure stainless O2 line. Per the ECN-014 amendment (SEL-ISRU-001 Rev D updated s.8.2) the line carries (1) a dome-loaded fail-closed pressure regulator at the ISRU exit, (2) a spring-loaded relief valve downstream venting to vacuum and (3) a pneumatically actuated fail-closed isolation valve, SENTINEL-triggered - "in addition to the existing double-block-and-bleed at hab entry (HAB-001 s.10)" (Strategy v3.1 s.5.1); "the combined system provides four independent barriers" (the source does not enumerate the four; the count stays in the doc, rule 3). A check valve at hab entry, upstream of the double-block-and-bleed, prevents reverse flow during hab depressurisation. Set points stay in the source. Monitored and auto-closed by SeleniteSoftware::O2SupplyLineMonitoringFunction. Source: SEL-ISRU-001 Rev D updated s.8.2 (ECN-014 amendment); updated_SEL-CAD-ISRU-001 Rev A ECN-014 amendment (SEL-ISRU-REG-001).
KREEP processing liberates oxygen as a by-product; stored before any dumping (SEL-ECN-027) and lofted as LOX on MD-2 at P14+ (SEL-ECON-001 Rev A revised s.8.4).
MSR process heat (200-300 degC) dual-purposed for acid baking (fleet v9 s.18.2); typed as a power port pending a heat item at Wave 5.
